data.content_ref: inline:Kind: Integration. The isolated node integrates the 'retrospective' nature of biological evolution (SRC_005) with the 'prospective' aim of scientific inquiry to form a hybrid 'Cyclical Validation Loop.' In this integrated system, retrospective corroboration fuels prospective risk-taking, which in turn generates new data for retrospective filtering. Refuted If: It is shown that retrospective corroboration and prospective risk-taking operate in strictly separate, non-interacting phases of scientific practice, such that no feedback loop exists and the 'integration' is merely a sequential juxtaposition without causal interaction.
